title: stemmacantha carthamoides
intro: Stemmacantha carthamoides, commonly known as Khas or Khash, is a flowering plant belonging to the daisy family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases such as diabetes and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Stemmacantha carthamoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its pharmacological activities. Further research is needed to confirm the full range of health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
